foreign_retailer_indicator.title: Foreign Retailer Indicator
foreign_retailer_indicator.description: Indicates the transaction involves a foreign retailer. Only accepted value is 'F'. Supported only for Visa transactions with MCC 5262.

foreign_retailer_transaction_amount.title: Foreign Retailer Transaction Amount
foreign_retailer_transaction_amount.description: Portion of the transaction amount attributed to foreign retailers. Callers provide a numeric amount in major currency units; the SDK serializes it in minor currency units.
